description: Full-text search of wiki.postgresql.org (websearch syntax), current text by default; history=true searches every revision and returns per page its latest matching revision (rev_id, revision_url, author, comment, timestamp, is_current) and the match count. Read with get_wiki_page; cite the url. Operators (intitle:, from:, after:/before:, link:, /regex/) as in search. A commit SHA returns the pages citing it, and commit.

history.description: Every revision, not only the current text (default false)

since.description: With history: revisions at or after (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO-8601)

until.description: With history: revisions before the end of this date

name: search_wiki
